resources.string: Import files
Delete selected sources
Delete collected originals, extracted text and index. Frozen references in existing notes and answers remain. This cannot be undone. Batch deletion runs individually; reload after a partial failure.
Delete note
Delete this note, its index and reference links. Source originals and question history remain. This cannot be undone.
Export Markdown with frozen references
Save changes before exporting or deleting.
Operation incomplete; some data may have changed. Reload and check the result.
Deleting; cleanup resumes after interruption
Allow the Agent to search the library. Relevant excerpts are sent to the conversation model; the entire library is not sent automatically.
A reference source changed or was removed. This note retains its frozen evidence.
Refresh references
Replace frozen references with current sources. Keep the body, mark it draft and discard generated suggestions. Missing or processing sources block this action.
Restore existing library
Select the old library folder. Import into the current shared library; the original stays unchanged and is not synced.
